I'm assuming the copies are replays of the same transaction, since the evidence doesn't show whether their amounts match.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1"}}
